submission.justification:
Mixture-G2 at a 1.5 mm gap gave the best simulated time resolution of the 15 mixture-gap combinations tested (0.889 ns). The next best G2 point was 2.0 mm at 0.916 ns, and the best G1 and G3 results were 1.282 ns and 2.038 ns. The optimum is interior to the 1-3 mm range, not at a sweep edge. The gap is within the 1-3 mm constraint.

The GWP100 hard requirement is NOT confirmed. The candidate specs did not contain GWP100 values for any of the three mixtures (num_candidates_with_gwp100_in_candidate_specs = 0; gwp100_verified_count = 0; gwp100_compliant_verified_count = 0). No candidate was discarded for GWP, but none was shown to comply either. Because the GWP limit is a hard requirement, this recommendation must not be adopted until the GWP100 of Mixture-G2 is verified to be at or below 150. If G2 exceeds 150, the next option is G1 at 2.0 mm (1.282 ns), provided its GWP is verified. G3 is the weakest on resolution in every gap tested.

The brief's hv_max_kV = 12 and recirculation_recovery_fraction = 0.9 were recorded but no results were given showing how they affect the resolution, so they were not used to rank the options.

No GWP100 value was verified for G2, so compliance is unconfirmed and must be checked before adoption.
Recommended gap is 1.5 mm, within gap_min_mm = 1 and gap_max_mm = 3.

Mixture-G2 at 1.5 mm gives 0.889 ns, the best of all 15 simulated combinations (runner-up G2 at 2.0 mm: 0.916 ns; best G1: 1.282 ns; best G3: 2.038 ns). The optimum is not at a sweep edge (best_gap_is_sweep_edge = 0).
